Remark
[maximal isometry dimension under nonpositive Ricci curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0344 ↗ def:pet-ch8-symmetry-rank ↗ thm:pet-ch8-bochner-negative-ricci 1. ch8:8.4.6Let $(M^n,g)$ be a compact Riemannian $n$-manifold with $\dim (\iso (M,g))=n$ and $\mathrm{Ric}\le 0$. Show that $M$ is flat and $\pi _1=\mathbb {Z}^n$. (Hint: show $\widetilde M=\mathbb {R}^n$ and that the deck transformations have differential $I$, since they preserve a parallel orthonormal frame.)
